# PDF Converter

- Route: `/tools/pdf-converter`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `image`
- Slug: `pdf-converter`

## Summary

Convert PDFs to JPG or PNG images, and turn images into PDFs — all in one place. (Image tools)

## Details

The PDF converter handles both directions in one place: render a PDF’s pages to JPG or PNG images, or wrap an image into a PDF document. Upload a PDF and you get image-export controls; upload an image and you get image-to-PDF. Everything runs on our own servers.
### What it does
- Converts PDF pages to JPG or PNG at the resolution you choose.
- Converts JPG, PNG, and other images into single-page PDFs.
- Packages multi-page PDF exports into a tidy ZIP of numbered images.
- Adapts the form automatically to the file you upload.
### How to use it
1. Upload a file: Drop in a PDF, or an image like JPG or PNG.
2. Pick your output: For a PDF, choose JPG/PNG, pages, and DPI; for an image, the output is PDF.
3. Convert: We render or wrap your file on our server.
4. Download: Save a PDF, a single image, or a ZIP of page images.
### Supported formats
- Input: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp
- Output: jpg, png, pdf, zip (multi-page export)
- Upload a PDF for PDF→image; upload an image for image→PDF. The form adapts automatically.
- All-pages PDF export is delivered as a .zip of numbered images.
### Technical details
- PDF → image rendering uses Poppler (pdftoppm); image → PDF embeds JPGs losslessly and other formats with lossless Flate compression.
- Multi-page PDF exports are delivered as a .zip with sortable page-001/page-002 filenames.
- Image-to-PDF sizes the page to the image at 96 DPI; PDF-to-image defaults to 150 DPI and supports up to 300+ for print.
- A page-count limit protects against oversized PDFs.
### Use cases
- Mixed workflows: Switch between PDF→image and image→PDF without changing tools.
- Document prep: Turn images into PDFs for upload forms.
- Repurposing: Render PDF pages to images for slides or social.
- Quick previews: Generate a first-page image from any PDF.
### FAQ
Q: What can the PDF converter do?
A: It converts PDF pages to JPG or PNG images, and converts images (JPG, PNG, and more) into PDF documents — all in one free tool.
Q: How does it know which way to convert?
A: It adapts to your upload: a PDF shows image-export controls (format, pages, DPI), while an image is converted to a PDF.
Q: Can I convert a multi-page PDF to images?
A: Yes. Choose "all pages" and you get a ZIP containing one image per page, named page-001, page-002, and so on.

When to send a visitor here: Send visitors here when they want one place for PDF and image conversions in either direction: PDF pages to JPG or PNG images, or an image wrapped into a single-page PDF. Fits vague asks like "convert my PDF" or "PDF and image tool".
When to send them elsewhere: When the direction and format are already clear, the focused pages are simpler: PDF to JPG (pdf-to-jpg), PDF to PNG (pdf-to-png) or Image to PDF (image-to-pdf). It does not edit PDF content or merge pages.
